title: Lendflow Roundup | November 2026
summary: November's Lendflow Roundup covers expanded SBA lending capabilities through AI connectors, cash flow underwriting, alternative data, SBA broker referral programs, and 2026 SBA loan changes.
body_markdown:
This month, we're sharing what's new across Lendflow and exploring some of the biggest topics shaping lending in 2026. From expanded SBA capabilities through our AI connectors to fresh insights on cash flow underwriting, alternative credit data, and SBA program changes, November's Roundup brings together the latest product updates and resources for lenders, brokers, and platforms.


##### FEATURE RELEASES


### What We're Working On


#### [Lendflow Expands MCP Capabilities to Support SBA Loan Processing Through AI](https://www.lendflow.com/post/expanded-sba-lending-capabilities-through-lendflows-ai-connectors)


Lendflow is expanding its MCP capabilities to support more SBA lending workflows directly within AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok. This update will give lending teams new ways to manage SBA loan processes using natural language, helping streamline operations and reduce manual work.


##### BLOG


### What We're Talking About


#### [What Is Cash Flow Underwriting? A Guide for Modern Lenders](https://www.lendflow.com/post/what-is-cash-flow-underwriting)


Cash flow underwriting uses permissioned bank account data to show how borrowers earn, spend, and repay, alongside traditional credit files. This guide explains how lenders can use cash flow information alongside traditional underwriting data.


#### [Credit Bureau Data vs Alternative Data: What Lenders Should Know](https://www.lendflow.com/post/credit-bureau-data-vs-alternative-data-what-lenders-should-know)


Alternative data like cash flow and rent history adds to bureau data, not replaces it. Lenders get the best results by layering both in one waterfall.


#### [SBA Lender Broker Referral Programs: How They Work and How to Win](https://www.lendflow.com/post/sba-lender-broker-referral-programs-how-they-work-and-how-to-win)


SBA lenders pay brokers about 1–3% for qualified referrals, disclosed on Form 159. Win by matching each deal to the best-fit lender.


#### [SBA Loan Program Changes in 2026: What Lenders and Brokers Need to Know](https://www.lendflow.com/post/sba-loan-program-changes-2026)


Explore the major 2026 SBA program changes, how they affect lenders, brokers, and small businesses, and what to expect from SBA lending in 2027.
